name: Multicam Black Clothing Pack
teaser: This mod adds 4 pants, 6 tops and Door Kicker Bonnie Hat in Black Multicam colors
description_html:
This mod, unlike my previous mods, includes 4 pants, 6 tops and Door Kicker Bonnie Hat in the game, and does not replace anything.

Added:

Tops: Black Multicam UBACS, Black Multicam T-shirt Contractor, Black Multicam Zaslon, Black Multicam Night Patrol, Black Multicam MGS, Black Multicam Boss Delta.

Pants: Black Multicam Infiltrator, Black Multicam SPT, Black Multicam Usec Base, Black Multicam Sage Warrior.

You can buy clothes from Ragman for 1 LL.
